title: K8s self-heal
description: Live kubectl health check of the aix namespace; cheap model triages, Opus (FORCE) auto-fixes, HITL only for human-only blockers.
outputContract: Activity event with status+action; on auto_fix an Opus FORCE run that applies kubectl/manifest fixes and verifies; on hitl a HITL item + backlog ticket.

acceptanceCriteria: The run classifies namespace health via the cheap model and prints a JSON verdict.
Real outages (deployment unavailable, endpoint down, live CrashLoop/ImagePull) always escalate even if the cheap model says healthy.
auto_fix runs re-verify pods Running/Available and endpoint 2xx/3xx before finishing.
Human-only blockers file a HITL item plus a backlog ticket rather than looping.
deterministicChecks: kubectl -n aix get deploy -o json shows availableReplicas >= replicas after a fix
